result.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
result.description:
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to tackle problems beyond the reach of ordinary computers and is working with AI cloud partners to expand access to AI factories around the world.

Watch NVIDIA Founder and CEO Jensen Huang celebrate Firebird’s launch of the CIS region’s largest AI factory in Armenia, establishing a new AI computing hub powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure. The project is intended to bring global demand for AI infrastructure, local development opportunities, and new economic growth to the region

➡️ Learn more: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/firebird-ai-factory-armenia-blackwell-rubin-dsx

result.title: Next-Gen Enterprise AI: Powered by Infosys & NVIDIA
result.description:
See how Infosys and NVIDIA are accelerating enterprise generative AI at scale. By combining Infosys Topaz with NVIDIA’s advanced technology, businesses can rapidly deploy secure, production-grade solutions. This video highlights how Infosys utilizes NVIDIA NIM microservices for high-performance inference, NVIDIA NeMo for custom model tuning, and NeMo Guardrails to enforce safety and compliance controls across the enterprise.

Infosys- https://www.infosys.com/
NVIDIA - https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/solutions/ai/
